sections.title: Setting the standard in Aiken for *over thirty years*
body: Mitch Johnson Construction, Inc. has been helping set the standard for real estate development in Aiken, South Carolina since 1989. Mitch has an unparalleled track record of building elegant single-family homes, horse farms, barns and equestrian estates.

Our project designer works one on one with our clients to ensure their every need is met. Buyers have chosen Mitch Johnson Construction for a reason: we never compromise on quality and craftsmanship. We work to understand your dreams, and then turn them into a reality.
